cs.t: I highly recommend just building a Thin-ITX router. I have a post of how I built mine here:  http://penguindreams.org/blog/building-a-thin-itx-router/  I paid too much for parts. You can easily construct one of these for under $200. I'm sick of ARM and needing a different image per device. AVOID the ClearFog and BPI-R1:  http://penguindreams.org/blog/review-clearfog-pro/   http://penguindreams.org/blog/banana-pi-bpi-r1-fails-into-an...  I cannot recommend either of them (although if I had to, the BPI-R1 is better than the ClearFog. Just don't expect it to be stable)
